blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The University of the Philippines College of Media and Communication (UP CMC) and its official student publication, Tinig ng Plaridel (TNP), have condemned the attempted arrest of two student-journalists while covering a workers’ protest march in Manila. In a joint statement, the college and publication said the two staff members were documenting Manila Police District (MPD) officers carrying a protester to a police station at around 11 a.m. on Sunday, when they were allegedly subjected to verbal intimidation and attempts to apprehend them. The incident occurred as the student-journalists covered the All Workers Unity protest march from Liwasang […]...
